report:
Reviewed the complete edition claim and all five ordinary implementation associations and three ordinary test associations; no TODO or N/A evidence is present. Requirements are (1) an omitted edition uses the pinned toolchain's latest supported Rust edition, (2) explicit older supported editions are retained, and (3) unknown editions fail setup.

CompileTest::prepare defaults to 2024, validates the edition before materializing its temporary project, writes that same edition into Cargo.toml, and passes it to the independent rustc adapter. The captured rust-toolchain.toml pins nightly-2026-03-15; running rustc --help confirmed 2024 is its latest stable edition. The experimental future spelling is intentionally not a concrete supported fixture edition. Edition::parse accepts the four concrete editions 2015, 2018, 2021, and 2024, rejects other strings, and as_str preserves each. Added the coordinated association at Edition's implementation so this essential dependency is part of future review invalidation.

The sage-host metadata association reads Cargo target.edition and converts it without substituting a default. The driver association forwards it to the embedded rustc --edition argument, root LocalModSym, and local_crate_with_edition; the latter checks root/crate agreement. The harness rustc association passes the chosen edition directly to the independent compiler invocation. Thus the explicit option reaches both execution paths, and the default is consistent with the current pinned toolchain. Captured observe::collect context confirms prepare renders the collected diagnostics used by the edition regression assertion.

Test adequacy: default_edition_supplies_into_future_but_2021_does_not supplies the same IntoFuture-dependent program with no edition and explicit 2021. Unwrapping default preparation requires both compilers to accept it with no unmarked diagnostics; the older variant requires a shared ERROR and asserts Sage's unresolved-trait diagnostic. This detects a default regression or loss of the explicit override on either compiler path. unknown_edition_fails_setup asserts preparation rejects future with the specific unknown-edition setup error. explicit_edition_and_rustc_warning_marker additionally exercises edition: 2021 through the public macro, successful preparation, a rustc warning marker and an empty Sage diagnostic snapshot. Historical 2015/2018 values share the inspected parse/manifest/argument propagation path; the edition-sensitive 2021 scenario supplies meaningful behavioral coverage of that option. No behavioral discrepancy was found.

Execution: cargo test -p sage-test-harness edition -- --nocapture passed five selected tests, including all three associated tests, plus pinned_rustc_checks_errors_editions_and_normal_library_configuration and an existing derive-edition test. The test run preceded only the association-comment edit; cargo fmt ran afterward. No production behavior was modified. Workspace build and delegated post-codegen/sanity checks remain the coordinator's overall-change verification; this report does not claim those commands were run by this reviewer.
